result.topic_en: Calculations on the functions $k=\sqrt{dz/d\eta}$ and $k_1=\eta\sqrt{dz/d\eta}$ in Riemann's minimal-surface theory, showing that both satisfy the same second-order linear equation; near a branch point $a$ with corner angle $\alpha\pi$, local exponents are found via $\log\eta=\alpha\log z+\text{const}$ and the elliptic-type differential $dv$.

methods.what: Hence $k$ and $k_1$ satisfy the same second-order linear ODE $k''/k = k_1''/k_1$
Elliptic-type differential with four branch points
Local behaviour at a corner of angle $\alpha\pi$: $\log\eta=\alpha\log z$ + regular function
Local uniformization near branch point: $v$ behaves like $2(z-a)^{1/2}/\sqrt{f'(a)}$
Local exponents of the two solutions at $a$
